chunks: From him (Al-Shaykh), from his father, from Hariz, from Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: I was with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and a man from our companions entered upon him and said: O my master, how do you view this verse: 'Only those respond who hear'?
He said: It refers to the disbelievers. Indeed, 'those who hear' are the People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt), and they respond to God, His Messenger, and their guardians.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'those who hear' in the Quranic verse according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In Kamal al-Din, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interpreting the verse 'Only those respond who hear' (39:9) by distinguishing between the general auditory hearing of the masses and the specific spiritual perception of the Ahl al-Bayt, who are the true responders to divine command. This exegesis highlights the Shia doctrine that true responsiveness to God is contingent upon the spiritual authority and inner knowledge of the Imams, elevating them above the general congregation in their capacity to enact divine will. Such interpretation underscores the theological link between prophetic knowledge and the ability to truly 'hear' and obey God's call.
